## Failures vs prior
  v1 study (n_jobs=4, no pre-warm):  8.3%
  v2 study (n_jobs=8, with pre-warm): 7.7%
  Goal was <1.0% — NOT MET.

      71  InvalidIndexError: Reindexing only valid with uniquely valued Index objects
       6  TypeError: Cannot compare tz-naive and tz-aware timestamps

  Root-cause refinement: my earlier hypothesis (pre-warm row indexes
  of featured_data and price_data) did not address the actual race.
  The InvalidIndexError actually fires inside the per-trial vectorized
  predict block: pd.concat(non_empty) and stacked[list(FEATURE_COLS)]
  construct FRESH MultiIndex / Column Index objects per trial, and
  their hash engines build lazily under thread contention. Pre-warming
  shared structures helped only marginally (8.3 -> 7.7%). A real fix
  needs either (a) building one shared stacked DataFrame in
  _load_shared_data and reusing it across trials, or (b) constructing
  the per-trial DataFrames with eager hash table instantiation. Both
  involve changes Outside this segment's scope. Flagging for follow-up.

## Pruning
  Pruned: 34/1000 = 3.4%
  v1 study pruning was: 8.3%
  Pruning fell with no rule changes — TPE narrowed around the viable
  weight region faster on this run, possibly because the v2 macro
  composite produced a smoother score landscape (tighter score
  distribution => steadier objective gradient).
